# ISO-Tool dependency matrix

The synchronized dependency contract covers Git/Python/CMake as baseline requirements; GCC/G++, MSVC, Clang/LLD, NASM/MASM, Ninja/MSBuild/Make, xorriso/Oscdimg, QEMU, Java/javac, .NET, Node/npm, Go, Rust and archive tools as optional or source-dependent capabilities. Detection is PATH-first, records versions and preserves fail-forward behavior. Explicit installation is required for downloads or persistent environment changes.
